top_signal.title: What are hidden cost and headaches to hiring your first employee?
top_signal.summary: I'm a very small business, but I think I'm reaching the point where I need to hire a part-time employee to help me. I know bringing someone on is a lot of work, but I'm struggling with the known unknowns and unknown unknowns side of hiring an employee.    Is there a specific expert I should talk to who can help? My state has a lot of resources for business owners; should I start there first to see if they can guide me through the process and what I should worry about?       submitted by     /u/lil_tink_tink       [link]       [comments]
